description: Plan a local Image Puma batch. For Magick-style jobs pass quality, format, and lossless here — do not call list_presets or settings_schema first. Accepts Windows paths, paths with spaces, and file:// URLs.

customSettings.description: Advanced nested settings. Prefer top-level quality, format, and lossless for Magick-style jobs.

format.description: Output format. Combined with quality like magick -quality N file.webp.

inputs.description: Local image files or folders. Windows paths, quoted paths, and file:// URLs are accepted.

lossless.description: Lossless WebP/AVIF when true. Use for logos and flat graphics.

outputDir.description: Directory to write into. Must be inside an allowed folder.

presetId.description: Built-in or user preset. Omit to keep Magick-style quality/format jobs simple: no resize, WebP unless format is set.

quality.description: ImageMagick-style quality 1-100 for JPEG, WebP, and AVIF. Maps PNG compression too.

name: image_puma_plan

errors.description: Non-empty means the plan cannot be run as-is.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp after which the plan can no longer be run.

job.description: Format, quality, lossless, and resize the run would apply.

resize.description: none, or a short resize like "fit-box 1920x1920".

planId.description: Handle to pass to image_puma_run after the user confirms.

plannedOutputs.description: Every file the run would write.

title: Plan Image Puma Batch
